name: Vruksha Table
tagline: Two sculptural forms, each with its own rhythm.on
story: Vruksha & Mani is a pair of sculptural side-table designs shaped by two contrasting ideas from nature. The larger table rises from a bold stepped base into a branching central form, evoking roots, growth, and the untamed energy of a tree. The smaller table takes a quieter, more rhythmic approach, with stacked rounded forms supporting a compact circular top. Together, the two designs balance movement and order, offering expressive surfaces that can be styled individually or brought together as a coordinated composition.
